description: A ultra‑fast, zero‑dependency Node.js framework that delivers Express‑level simplicity with Fastify‑grade performance – ready for edge, serverless and AI‑driven workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 surge in edge‑computing and AI‑ready back‑ends by positioning yantravese as the *only* zero‑dependency framework that ships with native ESM, optional TypeScript typings, and built‑in support for serverless adapters (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Netlify). Highlight the 30‑commit sprint that introduced a pluggable security layer (CSP, rate‑limit, JWT) and a declarative routing DSL that outperforms Express by up to 3× in benchmark suites. Emphasize the “no‑install‑chain” advantage: drop the single npm package into any Node, Deno or Bun runtime and start serving instantly.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for blazing‑fast request handling without pulling in a giant dependency tree.
Performance: Benchmarks show 2.5‑3× lower latency vs Express and 30% less memory than Fastify under identical loads.
Developer experience: Zero‑config routing, built‑in security middleware, TypeScript definitions, and one‑line serverless adapters make prototyping and production deployment frictionless.
